# java.binary options: several main classes need `main`, which picks one
# and must name a class on the class path;
# `output` names the directory and the jar; JDK 25's instance `void main()`
# is found; and two class path jars with the same file name both reach
# `lib/`.
[!exec:javac] skip

# Two static main classes and no `main`: the error names both, but not
# Gamma, whose instance main loses to them.
! bit ambiguous
stderr 'several classes in .*tools\.jar have a main method, so set `main` to one of demo\.Alpha, demo\.Beta$'

# A `main` no class path jar holds fails before anything is packaged.
! bit missing
stderr 'main class demo\.Delta is in no `classpath` jar: no jar holds demo/Delta\.class$'
! exists tools/build/tools/tools.jar

bit beta
stdout 'beta ✔ ok'
exists dist/beta-app/beta-app.jar
exec java -jar dist/beta-app/beta-app.jar
stdout '\Abeta\n\z'

# An instance main method with no parameters, JDK 25's simplest form.
bit simple
exec java -jar simple/build/simple/simple.jar
stdout '\Ainstance main\n\z'

# Two libraries whose jars are both named util.jar.
bit both
exec ls both/build/both/lib
stdout '^util\.jar$'
stdout '^util-2\.jar$'
exec java -jar both/build/both/both.jar
stdout '\Afirst second\n\z'

-- BUILD.bit --
explicit tools = java.library {
  dir = "tools"
}

explicit ambiguous = java.binary {
  dir       = "tools"
  classpath = tools.classpath
}

explicit beta = java.binary {
  dir       = "tools"
  classpath = tools.classpath
  main      = "demo.Beta"
  output    = "../dist/beta-app"
}

explicit missing = java.binary {
  dir       = "tools"
  classpath = tools.classpath
  main      = "demo.Delta"
}

explicit simple-lib = java.library {
  dir = "simple"
}

explicit simple = java.binary {
  dir       = "simple"
  classpath = simple-lib.classpath
}

explicit first = java.library {
  dir = "first/util"
}

explicit second = java.library {
  dir = "second/util"
}

explicit both-lib = java.library {
  dir       = "both"
  classpath = first.classpath + second.classpath
}

explicit both = java.binary {
  dir       = "both"
  classpath = both-lib.classpath
}
-- tools/src/main/java/demo/Alpha.java --
package demo;

public class Alpha {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        System.out.println("alpha");
    }
}
-- tools/src/main/java/demo/Beta.java --
package demo;

public class Beta {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        System.out.println("beta");
    }
}
-- tools/src/main/java/demo/Gamma.java --
package demo;

public class Gamma {
    void main() {
        System.out.println("gamma");
    }
}
-- simple/src/main/java/demo/Simple.java --
package demo;

public class Simple {
    void main() {
        System.out.println("instance main");
    }
}
-- first/util/src/main/java/first/First.java --
package first;

public class First {
    public static String word() {
        return "first";
    }
}
-- second/util/src/main/java/second/Second.java --
package second;

public class Second {
    public static String word() {
        return "second";
    }
}
-- both/src/main/java/demo/Both.java --
package demo;

public class Both {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        System.out.println(first.First.word() + " " + second.Second.word());
    }
}
